Name: Dynamic Golem Rename (Reconfiguration)
Author: BeazNees
Description:
[b]Dynamic Golem Rename[/b] (or Reconfiguration, if you'd rather call it that) is a simple mod that changes monsters named "Golem" to a different term. You can have them all be called the same, or mix and match terms. There's also an option to add your own custom terms, which will be explained below. 

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golem#]Golems [/url]are of a park of Jewish Folklore. They are creatures made by Clay or Mud, meant to be serve as protectors for Jewish communities. 
In modern culture, the word is used to describe any vaguely anthropomorphic creature made by a magic user.

I, for one, think we have enough terms to describe a homunculi, and don't really think the term is rather fitting to the monsters in Stardew. They just seem to endlessly spawn, and no where is it inferred that anyone/any creature created them for a purpose, which is really what Golems are all about. They might as well be called "Creatures", which is what this mod does.

[b][size=5]Features[/size]

[/b]Let's you change the term used for 3 monsters; Stone Golem, Wilderness Golem & Iridium Golem (I know the last one is just a variation of the Wilderness Golem but let me have my fun!) independently of each other. 

This mod only edits the [i]Display Name[/i] for these monsters, nothing else. 

[b][size=5]Config Options[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Stone Term:[/b] Toggles one of the preset terms to be applied for the Stone Golem. Options: Custom, Construct, Spirit, Elemental, Husk, Homunculus
[*][b]Custom Stone Term:[/b] [i]Only matters if the option above (Stone Term) is set to "Custom".[/i] Let's you type a specific term to use for the Stone Golem.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Wilderness Term:[/b] Toggles one of the preset terms to be applied for the Wilderness Golem. Options: Custom, Construct, Spirit, Elemental, Husk, Homunculus 
[*][b]Custom Wilderness Term:[/b] [i]Only [i]matters [/i]if the option above (Wilderness Term) is set to "Custom".[/i] Let's you type a specific term to use for the Wilderness Golem.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Iridium Term:[/b] Toggles one of the preset terms to be applied for the Iridium Golem. Options: Custom, Construct, Spirit, Elemental, Husk, Homunculus
[*][b]Custom Iridium Term:[/b] [i]Only [i]matters [/i]if the option above (Iridium Term) is set to "Custom".[/i] Let's you type a specific term to use for the Iridium Golem.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Compatible with any mod that [i]doesn't[/i] edit the Display name for; Stone, Wilderness & Iridium Golem.
